column1: # scripts/pipeline/lean-module-rss.tsv -- per-module peak RSS of the real Lean compiler (module<TAB>wall_s<TAB>maxrss_kib<TAB>rc),
# heaviest first; the table build-native-host weights its compiler seats from (a module takes ceil(maxrss / (cap / seats))).
# build-native-host.sh reads this file by default when present; MINIDREGG_LEAN_RSS_FROM=F[:F..] merges further tables (per module the max).
# Measured 2026-10-27 on dregg-build (Hetzner ccx33, 8 dedicated vCPU / 32 GB, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4, 2 seats, cap 28G): the first
# cold build of main c77ef2f9 through build-native-host --umbrella, 1,308 modules (the 787-module Host.Main closure + the Minidregg
# umbrella) in 7,197 s, merged per module (max) with the 2026-10-17 burst5-a table (784 Host modules, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4).
# Re-measure: copy native-out/lean-module-rss.tsv of a cold build here, or pass it as MINIDREGG_LEAN_RSS_FROM.
